newsitem.title: UK: UK grains markets subdued by lower currency.
newsitem.headline: UK grains markets subdued by lower currency.

text.p: LIFFE grain futures closed higher on the back of easier sterling in subdued trading on the UK grain markets on Wednesday.
Cash prices were little changed, but brokers reported few players in the market.
No trade was reported on the fob market while only light trading in mainly nearby material was seen in the delivered sector.
LIFFE wheat futures finished with old crop 0.75 stg up while new crop was 0.40 stg higher to 0.35 lower on a turnover of 430 lots.
LIFFE barley futures closed 0.75 stg up after trading 15 lots.
Most active November wheat had 224 lots against it and closed with a last trade of 91.00 stg, 0.40 stg up.
